snippet.title: Anik Singal
snippet.description:
In May 2022, everything changed.

I was about to sell my 9-figure company. Retire. Focus on my kids.
Then the FTC showed up.

18 months. $15M gone.
A brutal lawsuit that almost ended everything.

But I didn’t quit.

I fought back—and built something better!
 
A first-of-its-kind AI-powered software that helps marketing and sales teams automatically audit and monitor their advertising for compliance.

And guess what? It’s working.

Because of the FTC, I stumbled onto something incredible—a solution that could protect thousands of businesses from the same challenges I faced.

📈 What I Do Now

Today, through my new holding company Ugentic AI, I invest in and partner with AI & Martech SaaS companies, using the same growth strategies that helped scale my past businesses.

💰 If you own an innovative AI or Martech SaaS company with a fully built-out product and are looking for an investor who can help you scale faster—let’s talk.

What you'll find here:
- Augmentatism philosophy and frameworks

- Ethical AI approaches for artists and professionals
- Building authentic human-AI collaborations

Join our Discord Server where 950+ creatives exploring the third path between AI dependency and AI rejection.

snippet.title: Silicon Valley Girl

Every week, Marina interviews the global tech leaders, CEOs and founders building the future of AI: Reid Hoffman (LinkedIn), Mustafa Suleyman (Microsoft AI), Aravind Srinivas (Perplexity AI), Mary Barra (General Motors), Thomas Dohmke (GitHub), Mike Krieger (Instagram/Anthropic), Mel Robbins and others. 

Topics: AI careers, future of work, AI tools, startup building, entrepreneurship, making money with AI, and career growth in the AI era.

Featured in the official program of the World Economic Forum in Davos 2026. Available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube.

New episodes every week.

snippet.title: Sandeep Swadia
snippet.description:
From homeless to billion-dollar boardrooms. From monk training to MIT. From stage concerts to M&A... I’ve lived more lives than a cat.

I've served as CEO and C-level exec at tech companies that created $40B+ in value. I also crashed and burned too. Failure teaches much faster than success.

Before business, I performed 1,000+ concerts with Grammy winners. As a teenager, I ran away from home, trained as a monk, and somehow ended up graduating from MIT. 

I started this channel to share guidance my 22-year-old self desperately needed but never got. Science, strategy, spirituality, and stories from your friend who’s been there, warts and all.

Currently, I live in the NYC area, serving on boards, advising AI startups and help ambitious leaders scale without losing themselves.

It's so awesome to see you here. Thank you, and I love you.

For brand partnerships,  podcast appearances, and speaking engagements, please reach out to Creative Artists Agency (CAA) at SwadiaSandeepGroup@CAA.com.
